profile.summary: A company based in Rodeo, California, that provides passenger transportation in the greater Bay Area. It serves school districts, senior centers and the healthcare industry, including daily home-to-school transportation for students with special needs. Its vehicles include sedans, minivans, wheelchair vans and taxis.
